style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

source.scene: Inspect the named asset collection; do not use an unrelated active scene

target.interpretation: Reward useful native modeling and decoration inspired by the target. Do not reject a change solely because it differs from the source. Reject target drift only when it harms the chosen style, readability, role or locked technical contract. Original part counts and weak shapes are not automatically constraints.

generation.inspection: Raw selected target expresses requested cartoon design exploration; native editor retains functional connection profiles and actual registration rather than target caps/framing. No post-generation pixel editing.

designFreedom: Improve forms, proportions, silhouette and structural construction
Add purposeful decorations and crafted detail
Replace awkward modeling and change nonfunctional topology or part counts
Rebuild native geometry, normals, materials and light to realize the better design
constraints.modularFamily: Exact approved native straight conveyor family settings, rail/deck cross-section at incoming/outgoing connection planes, deck elevation/socket and UV7-period24-frame phase contract are fixed. Improve curved interior support/rail/deck construction and purposeful details while keeping both open end profiles/tangents/ports continuous. ImageGen endcap bevel/framing drift is not a functional authority. Measure this corner original native intrinsic rotation, actual UV angular parameterization and incoming/outgoing tangents independently; never copy straight source orientation/action blindly. Show all4facings/all24plusclosure; native connected corner+compatible family straights and independent assemblies, exact approved Godot128/55/32 fractional filtering on contrasting backgrounds, fullRGB+alpha residual localization and temporal continuity.

qualityCriteria.appearance: Apply the approved warm soft native conveyor family. Preserve coral rail, blue-gray moving deck and honey wood with rounded edge highlights; no new artistic competition or asset-specific redesign required.
technical: Exact original complete published frame/root/sourceScale2/atlas layout and all24frames at12fps for N/E/S/W, plus nativeframe25closure.
Measure original intrinsic transform and actual directed curved/linear UV law and native action; explicitly bind original stored action when unbound. No copied wrong orientation/phase.

Preserve functional open ports/profiles/deckheight.64, footprint, cap identity and actual source envelope. The start/end cap physical top.7194 is distinct from ordinary corner/rail.695; do not truncate it to corner height.
Use exact approved family material/light/render/camera settings and compatible construction. Caps adapt only as needed to existing role.
Keep native editable source/recipe/resources and exact native/publication sampling; no raster fitting/painting/camera-card replacement.
evidence: Perasset source-contract audit, all100 nativecaptures, original24frame atlases and native action/root/ports checks.

Hash-bound equivalence to proven family/classes, proper connection/phase evidence and proportionate actual intendedsize/phone inspection. Reuse alreadyvalidated consumer cases where exact equivalence is demonstrated, clearly label reused vs actual tests. No repeated giant matrices for rotations.
Coordinator technical validation receipt identifies recipe reuse and independentReview:false, binds exact packet/recipe/policy/evidence and inspected views. No fabricated judge approval.

delivery.scope: Refine this object only. Root coordinator promotes approved atlases, sources and metadata to production, publishes the PR preview, and finally updates Godot.
delivery.notes: Write source/round-NN.blend or the actual native 2D source as appropriate; full native captures, original-layout atlases, previews, validation and delivery.json. Do not label 2D artwork as a Blender model.
delivery.acceptance: Coordinator technical recipe validation; no new independent artistic judge for conveyors, per direct user instruction.
